ITEMS.product_name: Lizol Disinfectant Surface Cleaner - Floral (1 Litre)
ITEMS.dilution_ratio: Mix 15ml per 1 litre of water for daily cleaning
ITEMS.usage_guidance: For daily cleaning, add 15ml of Lizol to 1 litre of water. Mop the surface gently. No need to rinse. For tough stains, use undiluted and let it sit for 5 minutes before scrubbing.
ITEMS.safety_notes: Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. In case of contact, rinse immediately with plenty of water and seek medical advice. Do not ingest.

ITEMS.usage_guidance: Shake well before use. Spray directly onto the stained area. Gently agitate with a clean cloth or soft brush. Blot with a damp cloth to remove residue. Allow to air dry completely.
ITEMS.safety_notes: Test on an inconspicuous area first for colorfastness. Avoid excessive wetting. Keep out of reach of children. Use in a well-ventilated area.

ITEMS.usage_guidance: Spray directly onto the glass or surface from a distance of 15-20 cm. Wipe immediately with a clean, dry, lint-free cloth or newspaper for a streak-free shine.
ITEMS.safety_notes: Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. Do not inhale spray directly. Do not use on varnished or polished wooden surfaces.

ITEMS.usage_guidance: Shake well. Hold can upright and spray onto a soft, clean cloth or directly onto the surface from about 15 cm. Wipe immediately with a clean cloth to polish and shine. Do not use on floors as it may make them slippery.
ITEMS.safety_notes: Extremely flammable aerosol. Pressurized container: May burst if heated. Keep away from heat, hot surfaces, sparks, open flames, and other ignition sources. No smoking. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid breathing spray.

ITEMS.product_name: Domex Fresh Guard Disinfectant Toilet Cleaner (500ml)
ITEMS.usage_guidance: Squeeze around the toilet bowl rim and under the rim. Leave for 20 minutes for best results, then brush gently and flush. For tough stains, leave overnight.
ITEMS.safety_notes: Corrosive. Causes severe skin burns and eye damage. Keep out of reach of children. Wear protective gloves/eye protection. Do not mix with other cleaners, especially bleach.

ITEMS.dilution_ratio: Ready to use for tough stains, or mix 15ml per 1 litre of water for daily cleaning
ITEMS.usage_guidance: For daily cleaning, spray onto surface, wait 1 minute, then wipe with a cloth. For tough stains, spray liberally, wait 5 minutes, scrub, and rinse.
ITEMS.safety_notes: Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes and skin. In case of contact, rinse immediately with plenty of water. Do not ingest. Use in a well-ventilated area.

ITEMS.product_name: Diversey Taski R10 Floor Cleaner Concentrate
ITEMS.dilution_ratio: Mix 20-40ml per 1 litre water (depending on soil level)
ITEMS.usage_guidance: For hard and concrete floors, dilute as recommended. Apply solution to the floor, scrub with a floor machine or stiff brush. Wet vacuum or mop to remove the dirty solution. Rinse with clean water if necessary for heavily soiled areas.
ITEMS.safety_notes: Wear protective gloves and eye protection. Avoid contact with skin and eyes. In case of contact, rinse immediately with plenty of water. Keep out of reach of children. Do not ingest.

ITEMS.usage_guidance: For daily mopping and disinfection of hard floors, dilute 15ml in 1 litre of water. Gently mop the surface. No need to rinse. For tough stains, use undiluted and let it sit for 5 minutes before scrubbing.
ITEMS.safety_notes: Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. In case of contact, rinse immediately with plenty of water and seek medical advice. Do not mix with other household cleaners.

ITEMS.usage_guidance: Spray directly onto glass or hard, non-porous surfaces. Wipe immediately with a clean, lint-free cloth or paper towel until dry and streak-free.
ITEMS.safety_notes: Keep out of reach of children. Avoid inhaling spray. Do not use on varnished or polished wooden surfaces.

ITEMS.usage_guidance: Shake well before use. Spray a light, even coat onto a clean, dry stainless steel surface from a distance of 6-8 inches. Wipe immediately with a clean, soft cloth, wiping in the direction of the metal grain. Buff lightly to a brilliant shine.
ITEMS.safety_notes: Extremely flammable aerosol. Keep away from heat, hot surfaces, sparks, open flames, and other ignition sources. No smoking. Pressurized container: Do not pierce or burn, even after use. Protect from sunlight. Do not expose to temperatures exceeding 50°C. Keep out of reach of children. Use in a well-ventilated area.

ITEMS.usage_guidance: Shake can well. Hold can upright 15-20 cm from pre-cleaned surface and spray until surface is covered with mist. Allow to air dry for 10 minutes to disinfect. For soft surfaces, spray until fabric is wet and allow to air dry.
ITEMS.safety_notes: Extremely flammable aerosol. Keep away from heat, hot surfaces, sparks, open flames, and other ignition sources. No smoking. Pressurized container: Do not pierce or burn, even after use. Protect from sunlight. Do not expose to temperatures exceeding 50°C. Keep out of reach of children and pets. Do not spray on skin, eyes, or clothing.
